# Praveen Kumar

> Principal AI Engineer at TrellisSoft in Bengaluru, India. I build speech, document and LLM systems and share tools, experiments and technical write-ups here.

This is an index of my public work. Project documentation and linked experiment results give the scope, setup and limitations. Reuse terms differ between repositories; check each project's license. Docuvera360 is a case study of professional work with closed-source code.

## Start here

- [Home](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/): selected work, recent writing and contact details.
- [About](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/about.html): background, experience and how I work.
- [Project directory](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/all-projects.html): tools, learning resources and professional case studies.
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/inboxpraveen): repositories and work in progress.
- [Writing](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/all-blogs.html): notes on model choice, training, inference and evaluation.
- [Atom feed](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/feed.xml): new articles.
- [Sitemap](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/sitemap.xml): pages on this site.

## Current tools

- [ThinkLess](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/ThinkLess/): Python library for agent decisions. Rules and small models handle routine cases, with an LLM for the rest. Pre-1.0. [Source](https://github.com/inboxpraveen/ThinkLess).
- [CleanFrame](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/Cleanframe/): clean CSVs and spreadsheets through saved recipes. Replay uses no model calls, records changes and stops when the incoming schema has changed. [Write-up](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-14.html).
- [MoM AI](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-8.html): turn recordings into transcripts, decisions and action items using local models or chosen providers, with background jobs and retries.
- [Easy-vLLM](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/Easy-vLLM/): estimate GPU memory needs and generate vLLM commands and Docker files in the browser. Memory figures are estimates, not measured deployment results. [Write-up](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-15.html).
- [Speech Annotation Tool](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-4.html): transcribe recordings, review the text and export speech datasets with local or provider models.
- [AudioFP](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-7.html): identify short audio clips and locate repeated sounds within longer recordings using spectral fingerprints.
- [contextsearch](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-1.html): local keyword, embedding and hybrid document search with source passages and optional reranking.
- [HabitFlow](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-6.html): a local-first habit tracker with streaks, plain-language insights, spreadsheet export and a Windows installer. Data stays in one SQLite file.
- [Coding-agent rules](https://github.com/inboxpraveen/Minimize-Cursor-Cost): rules and prompt templates to reduce unnecessary context and edits, with a benchmark for comparing cost and accepted changes.

## Experiments and writing

- [ggml-inference-lab](https://github.com/inboxpraveen/ggml-inference-lab): scripts, raw results and notes on inference, quantization, language adaptation and speaker diarization.
- [Choosing a model, an evaluation and a serving setup](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/blogs/blog-8.html): a process for working from a use case to quality, latency, memory and cost requirements.
- [Kavach PII 270M](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/blogs/blog-6.html): training and evaluating a small multilingual model for finding personal data, including data audits and failed experiments.
- [Training and shipping a Kaldi speaker diarizer](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/blogs/blog-5.html): x-vectors, back-end training, VBx and CPU deployment.
- [Teaching a small language model Hindi](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/blogs/blog-4.html): tokenizer extension, continued pretraining, supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on a laptop GPU.
- [Cerebras inference, worked out from public sources](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/blogs/blog-3.html): a bandwidth and latency analysis. This is source-based analysis, not a measurement from hardware I own.
- [Inference speed and accuracy across architectures](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/blogs/blog-2.html): CPU and GPU comparisons, a pre-check script and quantization choices.
- [Measuring llama.cpp on one laptop](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/blogs/blog-1.html): thread settings, CPU backends, GPU offload, KV cache types and speculative decoding.

## Learning resources and other projects

- [Py Internals](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/Py-Internals/): nine interactive Python sessions on names, objects, functions, classes, iteration, decorators, concurrency, exceptions and imports. Code under Apache-2.0, course content under CC BY-SA 4.0. [Write-up](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-13.html).
- [ML Algorithms from Scratch](https://github.com/inboxpraveen/ML-Algorithms-from-scratch): 28 machine learning algorithms in plain NumPy, from linear regression to XGBoost, UMAP and learning-to-rank, each with a runnable demo and a guide that explains the maths. Licensed under GPL-3.0. [Write-up](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-5.html).
- [Movie Recommendation System](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-3.html): content-based recommender with a training pipeline and a Django app: TF-IDF, SVD and top-50 cosine neighbours, a 16 MB model for 26,000 films.
- [Football Player Recommendations](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-10.html): compare player attributes and find similar players with a Flask app.
- [Autoencoders and Decoders](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-11.html): Keras examples for reconstruction, denoising and image retrieval.
- [Skin Lesion Classification](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-12.html): an educational HAM10000 classification project with training, evaluation and a demo. Not a clinical diagnostic tool.
- [Portfolio website](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-9.html): the HTML, CSS and JavaScript site behind these write-ups.

## Professional work

- [Docuvera360](https://inboxpraveen.github.io/projects/project-2.html): a case study of enterprise document and analytics work. Its code is closed source.
